instruction: Three-Storey Office Annex This task starts from scratch with no init_file inputs and no local reference images. Create an Archicad three-storey office annex with a compact circulation core and save the required output to C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc. 1. The output folder contains C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc with size at least 500 bytes. 2. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema. 3. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique. 4. The IFC model contains exactly 3 IfcBuildingStorey entities and exactly 12 IfcSpace entities. 5. The IFC model contains at least 3 IfcSlab entities, at least 1 IfcRoof entity, and at least 1 IfcStair entity. 6. The IFC model contains spaces with exactly these normalized names: G-RECEPTION, G-MEETING, G-CORRIDOR, G-STAIR, 1-OFFICE-1, 1-OFFICE-2, 1-CORRIDOR, 1-WC, 2-OFFICE-3, 2-OFFICE-4, 2-CORRIDOR, and 2-TERRACE. 7. G-RECEPTION, G-MEETING, G-CORRIDOR, and G-STAIR are assigned to one storey; 1-OFFICE-1, 1-OFFICE-2, 1-CORRIDOR, and 1-WC are assigned to a second storey; and 2-OFFICE-3, 2-OFFICE-4, 2-CORRIDOR, and 2-TERRACE are assigned to a third storey. 8. The IFC area quantities for the spaces are G-RECEPTION 20.0 m2, G-MEETING 20.0 m2, G-CORRIDOR 30.0 m2, G-STAIR 9.0 m2, 1-OFFICE-1 20.0 m2, 1-OFFICE-2 20.0 m2, 1-CORRIDOR 30.0 m2, 1-WC 7.5 m2, 2-OFFICE-3 20.0 m2, 2-OFFICE-4 20.0 m2, 2-CORRIDOR 30.0 m2, and 2-TERRACE 15.0 m2, each with tolerance +/-0.10 m2. 9. The total ground-level area is between 78.0 m2 and 80.0 m2, the total level-1 area is between 76.5 m2 and 78.5 m2, and the total level-2 area is between 84.0 m2 and 86.0 m2. Any item not explicitly required may vary.
